_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Manual Validation Plan
summary: Defines the contractor's methods, procedures, controls, and resources used to accomplish validation of technical manuals being procured and developed, submitted to the Government for review and acceptance prior to TM development.
use_relationship:
The Technical Manual (TM) Validation Plan defines the contractor's methods, procedures, controls, and resources that will be used to accomplish validation of the TM(s) being procured and developed. The plan is submitted to the Government for review and acceptance prior to development of the TM(s).

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

The following DID should be considered when TMs are being procured: DI-TMSS-81819, TM Validation Certificate.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The TM Validation Plan shall be presented in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The TM Validation Plan shall contain the scope of the validation effort including the methods, procedures, controls, and resources that will be used by the contractor to accomplish validation of TMs to ensure their technical adequacy, accuracy, and compliance with the provisions of the contract and Technical Manual Contract Requirement (TMCR). The plan shall also include the following:

children.title: Name and address of contractor and contract number
Submittal date for the plan
Identification of TMs to be validated
children.content: Include applicable TMCR number(s), TM identification number(s), and title(s) of the TM(s) to be validated.

children.title: Document Type Definition (DTD) Public Identifier(s) used to develop the TM(s) covered by the plan
The maintenance level(s) of the TM(s) to be validated (organizational, intermediate, and/or depot-level)
For TM revisions, identify the areas of the TM containing the revised material to be validated
Dates and location/facilities of specific validation events
Recommendation/identification of any combined validation/verification events
Location and/or facilities for validation conduct
A listing of the contractor's personnel (by name, organization, and role) who will be responsible for accomplishing the validation efforts
Support equipment, test equipment, materials, contractual end items, and tools, etc., required during validation
children.content: Identification of any next higher assembly(ies)/system(s) required to support the validation (e.g., if a procedure entails installing a black box on the system, then the system or a mock-up of one is the next higher assembly).

children.title: Location/facility-specific safety precautions
Location/facility-specific environmental requirements
A detailed description of the validation methods and procedures to be used shall include
Review against source data
Comparison to actual system/equipment
Demonstration of procedures on the actual system/equipment
For non-linear Interactive Electronic TMs (IETMs), a description of the approach to evaluate IETM usability (including visual and functional characteristics)
A detailed description of the specific parts of the TM to be validated and the specific method(s) to be used, such as
Analysis of results of the reviewed material against the source data
Comparison of the material to the actual equipment/system
Demonstration results of performing operational, troubleshooting, and maintenance procedures on the actual equipment/system
A listing and description of any proposed fault simulations that will be used to validate the troubleshooting procedures
A description of the record keeping methods to be used to document validation results and identity of the validation findings disposition process
